objective: Show a live word count, reading time and a short-description hint under the description box in the draft review.
requirements: Create src/lib/description-meter.ts. Import { readingMinutes, formatReadingTime } from "./reading-time.ts" (the merged helper; do not change it). Export const DESCRIPTION_MIN_WORDS = 30.

Export function describeDescription(text: string): string. Count words as the non-empty pieces of text.trim() split on whitespace. Return `${words} word` + (words === 1 ? '' : 's') + ' · ' + formatReadingTime(readingMinutes(text)), and when words < DESCRIPTION_MIN_WORDS append ' · Short: aim for at least 30 words'.

In src/app/dashboard/draft-review.tsx add import { describeDescription } from "@/lib/description-meter"; and directly after the "Reviewed description" textarea (before the review-actions div) render

{describeDescription(description)}

. It reads the description being edited and saves nothing; change nothing else.
Use anchored edits for draft-review.tsx. Plain TypeScript in the lib file (it runs under node --experimental-strip-types): no JSX, no path aliases.
